snippet.title: Love Is A Roguelite (LIAR) - Official Reveal Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Love Is A Roguelite (or LIAR for short), an upcoming game that is a unique hybrid where turn-based tactics meet deck-building and dating sim set, within a procedurally generated Love Story. The trailer introduces you to its characters, story, and gives a peek at gameplay.

Powered by the proprietary LoveSync system where your choices matter, you'll manage relationships alongside tactical card combat, utilizing multiple character classes and exploring 16 distinct romantic pairings across diverse gender and species variations. 

You'll need to complete multiple successful runs to reveal the complete story when Love is a Roguelite launches in Fall 2027 for Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Cloud.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
